messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands facing forward, then raises her right hand to cover her face and head while placing her left hand on her hip, before lowering her arm and turning slightly.","camera":"The camera is at a low angle, framing her from the shins up, and slowly pushes in to a medium shot.","clothing":"She wears a sleeveless leopard-print crop top, high-waisted green wide-leg pants, and open-toed sandals.","hair_color":"Her hair is bright red.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled up into a high bun or topknot.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin and a slim build stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"She stands on a paved plaza in front of an amusement park with a large Ferris wheel, a roller coaster, and a red 'Tickets' booth under a warm sunset sky."},"uncertain":["The exact footwear style is partly obscured by the pants hem."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's face appears altered to a different 3D-rendered identity with darker skin, while the red topknot hairstyle, leopard crop top, green pants, amusement-park setting, camera push-in, and pose sequence remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person with the reference person, matching facial features and body skin tone while preserving the original hairstyle, hair color, expression, clothing, scene, and motion.
uncertain: The new face cannot be confidently matched to the reference photo's exact facial features because the face is often obscured by the hand or shown at a distance/angle.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly darker and more contrasted than the source, especially in the first frames.
